## WhatsApp loyalty agent (tap-to-send)
No AI, no paid API. Every morning: reads sales from your Google Form sheet, applies your store playbook, and fills the **Today** tab with WhatsApp links. Tap each link, check the message, send.

1. Click **Run Demo (4 mock stores)** to see sample lists.
2. Follow setup/google-form.md, then set STORE_TYPE, SHOP_NAME and REVIEW_LINK in **Build Today's List**.
3. Old customers from your phone or register? Paste them into the **Old customers** tab once. A slow win-back campaign (about 20 a day) also asks for consent; mark Haan/Na in that tab as replies come in.
4. The **Broadcast lists** tab lists everyone who said yes, in groups of 256, for festival announcements.
5. 15% of customers are held out on purpose, so the Report tab can show whether messages bring people back.
